beats.why: The on-screen text only says 'hostile environment', so the viewer misses that the environment is doing the isolating work for Gray.
The on-screen text 'biology breaks the package' jumps ahead of the narration, which at this moment is still describing the desired simplistic belief rather than its breakdown.
The on-screen 'hacks YOUR chemistry' leads the viewer to think it's the reader's chemistry being affected, when the narration means the character Avery's internal chemical reaction.
